issue_context.title: CT, OM: no exemplars on first scrape for created timestamp compatible open metrics
issue_context.body:
### What did you do?

CNCF slack discussion: https://cloud-native.slack.com/archives/C02KR205UMU/p1728397164955929

Expect exemplars for counters/histograms/summaries on first scrape when `--enable-feature=exemplar-storage,created-timestamp-zero-ingestion`. 

I was adding a unit test for NHCB (#14978) and noticed that after calling [OpenMetricsParser.CreatedTimestamp](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/02d0de9987ad99dee5de21853715954fadb3239f/model/textparse/openmetricsparse.go#L260) , the parser doesn't return exemplars.

This is because when the parser first encounter a metric, it will peek ahead to get the created timestamp here: [Next](https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/02d0de9987ad99dee5de21853715954fadb3239f/model/textparse/openmetricsparse.go#L297). However `Next` starts by clearing any exemplars already processed on the series line .

To reproduce the issue, flip the order of exemplars and ct in the test framework: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/02d0de9987ad99dee5de21853715954fadb3239f/model/textparse/interface_test.go#L175

### What did you expect to see?

Expect exemplars for counters/histograms/summaries on first scrape when `--enable-feature=exemplar-storage,created-timestamp-zero-ingestion`. 

### What did you see instead? Under which circumstances?

Unit test simulating the first scrape fails. To reproduce the issue, flip the order of exemplars and ct in the test framework: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/02d0de9987ad99dee5de21853715954fadb3239f/model/textparse/interface_test.go#L175
